```{r}
library(readr)
mental_health <- read_csv("D:/xz/mental-health-inpatient-activity-deprivation.csv")
View(mental_health)
library(tidyverse)
mental_health_clean <- mental_health %>%
select(
SIMD,
PatientsRates,
FinancialYear,
Dataset,
HBR
)
View(mental_health_clean)
unique(mental_health_clean$FinancialYear)
unique(mental_health_clean$Dataset)
unique(mental_health_clean$HBR)
unique(mental_health_clean$SIMD)
library(tidyverse)
plot_data <- mental_health_clean %>%
filter(
FinancialYear == max(FinancialYear, na.rm = TRUE),
Dataset == "SMR04",
HBR == "S92000003",
SIMD %in% 1:5,
!is.na(PatientsRates)
) %>%
arrange(SIMD)
View(plot_data)
ggplot(plot_data,
aes(x = factor(SIMD), y = PatientsRates)) +
geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
labs(
title = "Mental Health Inpatient Rates by Deprivation",
x = "SIMD Quintile",
y = "Patients per 100,000 Population"
) +
theme_minimal()
ggplot(plot_data,
aes(x = factor(SIMD), y = PatientsRates)) +
geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
labs(
title = "Mental Health Inpatient Rates by Deprivation",
subtitle = paste("Financial Year:", unique(plot_data$FinancialYear)),
x = "SIMD Quintile",
y = "Patients per 100,000 Population"
) +
theme_minimal()
View(mental_health_clean)
library(tidyverse)
# Step 1: Select all years
plot_data_all <- mental_health_clean %>%
filter(
Dataset == "SMR04",
HBR == "S92000003",
SIMD %in% 1:5,
!is.na(PatientsRates)
)
# Step 2: Calculate average inpatient rate
plot_data_average <- plot_data_all %>%
group_by(SIMD) %>%
summarise(
PatientsRates = mean(PatientsRates),
.groups = "drop"
)
# Step 3: Create bar chart
ggplot(plot_data_average,
aes(x = factor(SIMD), y = PatientsRates)) +
geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
labs(
title = "Mental Health Inpatient Rates by Deprivation",
subtitle = paste(
"Average Rate:",
min(plot_data_all$FinancialYear),
"to",
max(plot_data_all$FinancialYear)
),
x = "SIMD Quintile",
y = "Patients per 100,000 Population"
) +
theme_minimal()
View(plot_data)
View(mental_health)
View(plot_data_all)
load("C:/final try/.RData")
View(plot_data_all)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
mental_health_mean <- mental_health %>%
group_by(FinancialYear, SIMD) %>%
summarise(mean_rate = mean(PatientsRates, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
ggplot(mental_health_mean, aes(x = FinancialYear, y = mean_rate, colour = factor(SIMD), group = factor(SIMD))) +
geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
labs(
x = "Financial Year",
y = "Mean psychiatric admission rate (per 100,000 population)",
colour = "SIMD quintile\n(1=most deprived, 5=least deprived)"
) +
theme_bw()
scale_x_discrete(breaks = c(
"1997/98",
"2002/03",
"2007/08",
"2012/13",
"2017/18",
"2022/23"
)) +
scale_x_discrete(breaks = c(
"1997/98",
"2002/03",
"2007/08",
"2012/13",
"2017/18",
"2022/23"
)) +
View(plot_data_average)

y = PatientsRates,
color = factor(SIMD),
```
